title: No Root, Hard Ceiling
description:
Platform policy just landed: Guestbook may not run as root, and it may not eat the node.

Harden the Deployment — `securityContext` as specified, plus CPU/memory **requests and limits** that match the brief. Soft limits or privileged leftovers fail the audit.

**Meant for:** securityContext + requests/limits.

problemStatement.brief: Harden Guestbook: non-root (and read-only root FS if required) plus CPU/memory requests and limits that match the brief.
